docs.title: Whats the point?
docs.text:
This is an example of an exercise to help farmers, donors, and project partners evaluate if insurance would have value. It is one use case—many others exist.

It is intended to catalyze key discussions for investment and adaptation opportunities insurance could de-risk and incentivise, and to provide a quantitative tool for people to evaluate if it is meeting its needs.

docs.title: Game Time!
docs.text:
Play to have fun--don’t take this too seriously!

You are a farmer…

You have a choice of taking out a loan for quality inputs that would make you much more productive in normal years

But you would lose the farm if there was a drought this year, because you wouldn’t be able to repay the loan

You have a 1 in 5 chance of drought.

We have 5 packages of gum in my hat.

  • The 4 blue ones represent a year with adequate rainfall

  • The 1 red one represents a year with a drought

We will randomly draw one of the packages from the hat, and if its red, there was a drought.

But first--make your choice!

  • Put your left thumb up if you take the chance

  • Put your left thumb down if you stay with your current, low productivity packagae

We typically add real world prices, etc. to the game But that’s no fun in a workshop so we will point you to tools to do that later!
